boards.reply: Agar plant ko sunlight se farq padta hai, idea test kijiye: do same plants, sirf light badliye, daily measure kijiye. Evidence kya batayega?
Pehle jo dikhta hai, usse observation kehte hain; phir us par testable question banate hain. Aap batayiye: doodh aur nimbu milane par kya badlega?
Do same plants rakhiye, sirf ek ko light dijiye; roz height naapkar compare kijiye. Isse kis cheez ka evidence milega?
Aap ek cheez dekhte hain, phir poochte hain: “Kya nimbu doodh ko badlega? ” Iska jawab test karke mil sakta hai.
Jaise cricket mein ball dekhkar decision hota hai: prediction ko observation aur measurement se check kijiye. Umpire ne kya observe kiya?
Science mein bhi pehle idea hota hai, phir observation aur measurement se check karte hain; sirf kisi authority ki baat enough nahi. Aap kya naapenge?
